script.spoken: It broke apart, and seventy three people were killed. A Boeing 707 ran out of fuel and crashed on a Long Island hillside. The flight was held in three holding patterns. Fuel ran low. The crew asked for priority, but never said emergency. After a missed approach, the engines flamed out. Controllers didn't grasp how little fuel was left. Fuel emergency terms were standardized.
